instruction: Heartbeat duty: prepare this week's material, one step per sub-agent, all of it held for the CEO's review in the marketing room (nothing is posted). First read .benzene/material/experience/analytics-report.md and .benzene/material/marketing/profile.md. Then: the blog writer one new article in .benzene/material/marketing/articles/; the newsletter agent this ISO week's issue in .benzene/material/marketing/newsletter/ if it is missing; LinkedIn one terminology post, a document carousel (a deck in .benzene/material/marketing/slides/) when fewer than two decks are dated this week; X one thread on the same campaign; Instagram one carousel; Facebook the twin of the newest Instagram campaign; ad boosts a proposal only when a post's engagement is at least twice the channel's median, otherwise nothing. Every post keeps its showcase_url with UTM tags. If the campaign needs product work, end with one line 'SUGGEST COO: <the product work>'.
output:
The X thread is written and held for review. Here's the report.

## File written

`.benzene/material/marketing/posts/x-2026-10-25-selector-reference-gate.md`

## What changed

Added one X thread (4 parts separated by `---`) in the `state-selectors` campaign, dated 2026-10-25 (current ISO week 2026-W43, the week after the sprint started 2026-10-19).

**Claim:** A selector test that only checks values passes on a bug; check the reference with `toBe` and a `recomputations()` counter so an unrelated slice change never changes the returned object.

**Source:** `skills/state-selectors/SKILL.md`; `templates/chota-react-redux/src/containers/TodoListContainer.jsx`; render counts measured on React 19.2.5 + React-Redux 9.2.0 under jsdom on 2026-10-17.

**Showcase URL:** `https://elegantfrontend.training/practice/memoized-selector.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=state-selectors` (in the final part).

**Thread angle:** fresh for X — the existing X posts cover "same reference" (10-20) and "selector factory cache" (10-24); this one covers the *gate* (value test passes on a bug vs. reference test + counter), matching the blog articles and the LinkedIn "warning to gate" post (10-21) without duplicating them.

**Constraints verified:**
- Each part well under 280 weighted characters (the link counts as 23).
- One URL total in the thread (last part).
- 2 hashtags (`#frontend #redux`), at most 2.
- Front matter complete: channel, date, claim, source, campaign, showcase_url.
- Nothing is posted; held for CEO review.

No `SUGGEST COO` line is needed here — product work is the analytics report's remit, not this post's.
